record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: passive status immunity checked inside Status.triggerBurn (no PassiveEffects entry)
record.summary: Passive.WATER_BUBBLE has no entry in PassiveEffects (queue uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY); the only code that reads it is Status.triggerBurn (status.ts:406). DEWPIDER (1 star) and ARAQUANID (2 stars) are WATER + BUG + AMORPHOUS, maxPP 100, range 1, skill STICKY_WEB; nothing reads stars. triggerBurn applies burn only if the target has no EffectEnum.IMMUNITY_BURN, status.runeProtect is false and pkm.passive !== WATER_BUBBLE; for a WATER_BUBBLE holder the whole block is skipped, so every burn request through triggerBurn (abilities, items such as Flame Orb's per-update re-application, dishes, passives) does nothing to this unit: no burn flag, no burnCooldown or burnOrigin update, no Rawst Berry eaten, no Guts / Well Baked / Magmarizer reaction and no burn tick damage. This is an immunity to the status, not damage reduction: damage dealt by the same ability or item is unaffected. Requested vs applied: the requested burn duration and the burn it would have caused are never applied; no stat is changed. The status is set by direct assignment in only one other place that could matter, PokemonEntity's clone-from-reference step copying status.burn and burnCooldown (pokemon-entity.ts:1560-1561), and Status.updateBurn / healBurn would still work on a copied burn; whether a Water Bubble holder can be the destination of that copy was not traced. The English text 'The Pokémon is immune to BURN' matches this reading. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: Any call to Status.triggerBurn on the holder (the check runs inside the method; there is no registered effect, trigger or timer)

effects.scaling: none; no AP, stars or stat scaling
effects.resolution: Requested: apply burn for the caller's duration. Applied: nothing for the holder (the guard fails, so burn, duration, origin and the on-burn reactions are all skipped). The guard is a passive-identity test, so it follows pkm.passive at the time of the call; changePassive on the entity would change it. Other statuses (poison, silence, etc.) are untouched; Rune Protect and IMMUNITY_BURN are separate guards in the same condition.

effects.kind: consequence for burn tick and heal
effects.resolution: Because burn is never set through triggerBurn for the holder, updateBurn deals no burn tick (burn damage 5 % of maxHP is the generic formula, not computed here) and healBurn exits early on !this.burn. Direct assignment of status.burn happens only in the COMATOSE spawn effect (sets false) and the clone-from-reference copy (copies the reference's burn).

conditions: Applies only through Status.triggerBurn; other burn sources that assign status.burn directly (clone copy, line 1560) are not covered by the guard
The guard is evaluated together with IMMUNITY_BURN and Rune Protect (all three must be absent for burn to apply)
record.resetBehaviour: No state; the check is stateless and re-evaluated at every triggerBurn call.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Whether a Water Bubble holder can receive status.burn through the clone-from-reference copy was not traced
The many triggerBurn callers (abilities, items, dishes, passives) were listed by name but not read; they all end in the same guard
